messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 7999990000 — high-sev: GCP asia-southeast4 GPU quota exceeded, autoscaler failing to provision new GPU nodes. Queue growth detected. Pager triggered. Details: createInstances API returning QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Please acknowledge. :rotating_light:

ops_oncall: ack. I'm on it.

alex_w: seeing large spike in inference queue; 95th latency > 10s and backlog ~4200 requests. Autoscaler logs show repeated create failures with error: "quotaExceeded: Insufficient 'NVIDIA_TESLA_V100' resource in region asia-southeast4 for project redwood-prod".

maya_p: tagging runbook: runbooks/gpu-quota.json -> step 1: confirm exact quota metric, step 2: failover routing, step 3: request quota increase if needed.

oncall-bot: link to runbook https://internal/runbooks/gpu-quota (automated).

jordan_s: running quick check on quotas: `gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast4 --project=redwood-prod --format="json(quotas)"`

jordan_s: output snippet:
```
"quotas": [
  {"metric": "GPUS_ALL_REGIONS", "limit": 0, "usage": 0},
  {"metric": "NVIDIA_TESLA_V100", "limit": 8, "usage": 8, "status": "EXHAUSTED"}
]
```

ops_oncall: confirmed. Project quota for V100 at limit 8, usage 8. Autoscaler tried to create 4 more nodes and was blocked.

lee_infra: moving to escalate to cloud-ops; prepping support request. Drafting message for GCP support with timestamps and error payloads.

sam_cs: any customer impact? I have two customers reporting timeouts on hosted endpoints. Need ETA for mitigation to update them.

alex_w: high-tier hosted customers seeing 502/timeouts on long prompts. We should throttle new request acceptance and enable degraded fallback to smaller models to reduce queue.

maya_p: can we route some traffic to us-central1 and eu-west1 pools? If model variants available, route to quantized variant to reduce GPU memory per instance.

ops_oncall: doing partial mitigation: enabling route fallback policy to send non-SLA traffic to us-central1. Applying policy now.

ops_oncall: `curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/v1/fallback -d '{"from_region":"asia-southeast4","to":"us-central1","filter":"non-sla"}'` -> 200 OK.

jordan_s: starting autoscaler fallback: reduce requested accelerator type from V100 to T4 for ephemeral warm pool to fit within remaining quota in other zones. Running command: `kops update instancegroup --name=rg-warm --set accelerators=type=nvidia-t4,count=1`

oncall-bot: NOTE: changing accelerator types can affect model performance. Confirmed with infra that T4 quantized model is available and tested.

lee_infra: submitted GCP support case 1234567890 titled "Quota limit hit for NVIDIA_TESLA_V100 in asia-southeast4 — urgent". Sent escalation to L2. ETA unknown.

alex_w: workaround attempt: spin up 4 T4 nodes in asia-southeast4 (T4 quota is available) and fallback lower-quality model there. Starting template apply.

ops_oncall: applied temporary rate-limiter for non-critical routes: 30% of baseline to reduce incoming pressure. `rbacctl set-rate --route "non-sla*" --p75 0.3`

sam_cs: shared initial customer note: "We're investigating increased timeouts in APAC region; traffic may be routed to other regions temporarily." :white_check_mark:

jordan_s: logs from autoscaler around 7999990123:
```
E createInstances failed: quotaExceeded: Insufficient resources for requesting 'NVIDIA_TESLA_V100'
I attempted 3 times across pools: asia-southeast4-a/b/c
Autoscaler paused new scale attempts for 60s
Queue length: 4218
```

maya_p: plan update: 1) keep routing fallback in place, 2) spin T4 warm pool and deploy quantized model, 3) request quota bump with GCP support (and escalate), 4) if ETA > 30m, further reduce non-SLA throughput and notify customers.

ops_oncall: executing step 2 now — provisioning T4 nodes. `gcloud compute instances create rg-warm-t4-1 --zone=asia-southeast4-a --accelerator="type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1" --project=redwood-prod`

ops_oncall: create succeeded, warm pool size +1. Deploying quantized model to that pool.

alex_w: traffic shifted to quantized model for degraded endpoints. Latency P95 dropped from 10s -> 4.6s for routed traffic. Queue decreasing slowly: now 2800.

lee_infra: GCP support responded: case 1234567890 -> "Quota increase request submitted to internal quota team; review expected within 4 hours, expedited review requested." Not great.

ops_oncall: pushing for cross-region routing to shed load further. Initiating emergency throttling for free-tier and trial customers to preserve capacity for paid tier.

sam_cs: posted updated message to affected customers channel. Will hold off on broader status page until we have concrete ETA.

jordan_s: note: autoscaler still attempting to create V100 in asia-southeast4 and getting denied; we've disabled V100 pool growth temporarily to avoid wasted attempts. `autoscaler set-policy --pool=v100-pool --max-inflight=0`

maya_p: good call. Also toggled aggressive cache TTL for embeddings to reduce repeated inference pressure.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (7999990460): mitigation in progress. Queue reduced to ~1700 after routing and T4 warm pool. Degraded service still in APAC; paid customers largely unaffected due to preserved capacity.

lee_infra: follow-up: considering moving some reserved Dedicated capacity for a small number of customers into asia-southeast4 via manual uplift to avoid live impact if quota increase delayed. Requesting approvals.

ops_oncall: approvals granted for 2 reserved nodes temporarily. Provisioning using existing dedicated quota.

alex_w: monitoring: latency P95 for global SHARED endpoints back to 1.2s, APAC-hosted endpoints P95 at 3.8–5.0s depending on routing. Queue trending down to 620.

sam_cs: customer comms updated: one major customer acknowledged fallback and will monitor.

jordan_s: final notes before handoff to next shift: GCP quota increase pending, we've mitigated with T4 warm pool, routing fallback, and rate limits. Need next on-call to watch for re-try storms when GCP quota is lifted and autoscaler resumes creating V100 nodes. Recommend manual unpause of V100 autoscaler when quota confirmed.

ops_oncall: handing off to next oncall (shift change at 7999990860). Handoff summary pinned to thread. :memo:

oncall-bot: HANDOFF at 7999990860 — incident state: mitigated but open. Next steps: monitor queue, coordinate with cloud-ops on quota, decide on permanent scaling policy for asia-southeast4 to avoid reliance on V100-only capacity.

sam_cs: thanks team. I'll send a follow-up customer note in 30m with current state and expected next updates. :pray:
